title: Ajanta Caves
visualBrief: Ajanta Caves main horseshoe-cliff exterior,with28 numbered frontage reconstructions:23 current map-controlled entrances,three interpolated gaps and two estimated endpoints. Includes open recessed porticos,selected double-height galleries,picture-guided chaitya facades9/10/19/26 with large arched windows and door groups,a connecting ledge and layered basalt rock shell. The archaeological boundary is retained only as evidence. Upper excavations29/30,fine sculpture,paintings,deep/navigable interiors,trees,river,bridges,modern visitor buildings and engineering are excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q184427 way/115567314 preserves its archaeological-site boundary,anchor,undirected axis,original tags and empty dimensions. That boundary is not extruded. Standard PMTiles supplies23 coherent numbered entrance points on the horseshoe cliff,plus two valley-displaced labels27/28 retained as rejected controls. Caves3/18/20 are interpolated gaps and27/28 are estimated endpoint continuations. The frontage is one connected rock-cut landform;not a collection of separate buildings or a surveyed cave plan.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No architectural height facts or entrance elevations are supplied. Raw standard DEM heights at the23 mapped and five inferred frontage positions are retained. The review ledge uses their median plus15 percent of local deviation to avoid treating the coarse sloping DEM as surveyed cave thresholds. Cliff bottoms extend to sampled valley-side grade or10 m below the ledge;tops meet sampled rear grade or18 m above the ledge. Cave widths,depths,opening heights,chaitya proportions,upper galleries and rock strata are original picture-guided estimates. Unverified upper excavations29/30,exact sculptures,paintings and interiors are not reconstructed.

reconstruction.rawHeightBasis: rawHeight and ledgeMedian retain the original DEM datum; floorY and section heights use the rebased model datum.
